# Office of Accessible Education

> Stanford's Office of Accessible Education (OAE) provides comprehensive disability accommodations, accessibility services, and support for students with disabilities across academic and campus life.

OAE serves as the central resource for disability services at Stanford University, managing student registration, academic accommodations, testing services, and accessibility compliance. The office works with students, faculty, staff, and prospective students to ensure equal access to education through legally-mandated accommodations and assistive technology support.

## Key Topics

- Disability accommodations
- Academic accommodations
- OAE CONNECT (accommodation management system)
- Exam accommodations
- Assistive technology evaluations
- Centralized Testing Center
- FERPA (privacy and records)
- Interpreting and captioning services
- Student registration
- Disability adviser
- Accessibility services
- Student accessibility rights
- Documentation guidelines
- Study abroad accommodations
- Reduced courseload petitions

## Getting Started

- [Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu): OAE homepage introducing disability services and accessible education at Stanford
- [Students | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students): Main student hub for registration, accommodations, and OAE resources
- [Prospective Students FAQs | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students/prospective-students-faqs): FAQs for prospective students about admissions and OAE accommodations
- [Dispelling Myths About the OAE | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students/dispelling-myths-about-oae): Myth-busting resource on OAE registration and disability adviser services

## Academic Accommodations

- [Academic Accommodations | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/faculty-staff/academic-accommodations): Faculty/staff guide to legally-mandated academic accommodations via OAE CONNECT
- [Exam Accommodations for Students | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students%23academic-accommodations-services-button/exam-accommodations-students): Guide to exam accommodations including extended time and distraction-reduced testing
- [Centralized Testing Center (CTC) | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/ctc): CTC resource for exam proctoring, assistive technology, and testing logistics
- [Class Participation Accommodations | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students%23academic-accommodations-services-button/class-participation-accommodations): Alternative class participation formats for students with disability-related challenges
- [Assignment Extensions | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students%23academic-accommodations-services-button/assignment-extensions): Assignment extension accommodations for disability-related time management challenges
- [Attendance Flexibility | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students%23academic-accommodations-services-button/attendance-flexibility): Attendance accommodation for chronic and episodic disability-related absences
- [Reduced Courseload | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students%23academic-accommodations-services-button/reduced-courseload): Petition process for reduced course loads with financial aid implications
- [Requesting New or Additional Accommodations | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students%23academic-accommodations-services-button/requesting-new-or-additional-accommodations): How-to guide for requesting new or expanded accommodations via OAE CONNECT

## Accessibility Services

- [Interpreting and Captioning Services | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/faculty-staff/academic-accommodations/interpreting-and-captioning-services): ADA/Section 504 compliant sign language and live captioning services for students
- [Audio Recording Lectures | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students%23academic-accommodations-services-button/audio-recording-lectures): Guidelines for audio recording lecture accommodations with copyright policies
- [Assistive Tech Evaluations | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students%23academic-accommodations-services-button/assistive-tech-evaluations): OAE assistive technology evaluation and discovery services for academic support

## Documentation & Privacy

- [Documentation Guidelines | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/documentation-guidelines): Requirements for medical and functional evaluation documentation per DSM-5/ICD-10
- [OAE & Your Privacy | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students/getting-started/oae-and-your-privacy): Guide to OAE privacy practices and medical information handling for students
- [Your File & Documentation | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students/getting-started/oae-and-your-privacy/your-file-documentation): Documentation on FERPA compliance and file management for student records
- [Transitioning to College Websites | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students/prospective-students-faqs/transitioning-college-websites): Guide for transitioning from K-12 to college systems with FERPA privacy info

## Optional Resources

- [Study Abroad | Office of Accessible Education](https://oae.stanford.edu/students%23academic-accommodations-services-button/study-abroad): Planning accommodations for study abroad via Bing Overseas Studies Program
